name: evidence-search
description: Find and cite evidence in a project's code, requirements, design documents and configuration at low token cost: tiered search, bounded grep, mandatory cross-checks for enumeration and absence questions, and an evidence ledger of path:line citations. Ships an optional local index: SQLite FTS5 BM25 search with identifier-aware terms, tree-sitter method chunks for Java and JavaScript, heading sections for Markdown and AsciiDoc, related-chunk search across code and documents, a repo map, and a fact table of SQL tables, URLs, JSP includes, queues, config keys and project ids. Works on code that does not compile.
